fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of sorted unique modified/untracked paths, NUL, full file bytes, NUL; excludes tests/evidence/; includes preserved ADR-0024 and B1-B6 work

scope.manual_allocation: 30 calendar days remains the initial-review/default recommendation window; explicit confirmed-Fact allocation may search all dates with a mandatory reason
scope.target_search: same tenant/current confirmed opposite type/currency/available balance, literal field search, ID keyset, 50 per page; current targets retained separately
scope.correction: date-only changes do not invalidate cross-period links; currency, amount, current relationships and rollback checks remain
scope.bad_debt: Owner/Finance reasoned mark/unmark of active Payment/Invoice, exact version CAS, stable idempotency and append-only decision/audit
scope.single_state_source: latest fact_bad_debt_decisions entry; no duplicated Payment/Invoice flag or Trip lock column
scope.trip_protection: derived from direct active bad-debt Payment/Invoice assignments and active bad-debt Invoice allocations to an assigned Payment; prevents Trip deletion
scope.soft_delete: existing Fact soft-delete/relationship-end semantics retained; history and fixed Reimbursement snapshots are preserved

database.existing_data_over_active_link_cap: upgrade fails atomically without deleting or truncating data

critical_invariants.method: every mapped package/test matched a passing event in the uncached complete Go run; no test-only rerun or skipped mapping counted

statement_coverage.method: unique statement blocks with any positive count across all package profiles; existing layer boundaries unchanged

authenticated_restore.limit: focused nonempty regression fixtures; not a new 1000-Document exercise

web.browser_mode: Mock API component/browser regression, independently complemented by real PostgreSQL HTTP integration

visual_review.manual_image_inspection: allocation narrow light, Payment desktop dark and protected Trip narrow light; unchanged build in final rerun

resolved_gate_failures: Old manual cross-30-day rejection assertions were replaced by explicit allowance/default recommendation assertions under ADR-0031; currency, balance, permissions and rollback tests retained.

Full reviews package exceeded 60 seconds: pagination fixture retained 201 rows, all traversal/deletion/correction assertions and full source workflows for correction targets, while batching query-only records through real PostgreSQL constraints; no timeout or threshold increase.
Browser fixture route/capability mismatches corrected; the first full 116-case run was 115 pass/1 obsolete copy assertion fail, then the complete final run passed 116/116 without retries.

review.independent_read_only_review: no remaining blocking B7/B8 defects found
review.scope: B7/B8 implementation/contract/migration/tests reviewed; prior user-owned ADR-0024 and B1-B6 changes preserved
review.scan_limit: signature and file-scope review is not a guarantee that arbitrary secrets can be detected

resources.credentials: one-use synthetic file-only credentials under new owner-only /tmp; never emitted in argv, environment, repository, reports or responses

not_performed: new 1000-Document release exercise or deployed API/browser joint gate
commit, push, publish or running-user-instance upgrade
